extra_systems.note: Semi-parametric, retrieval-based decoding (nearest-neighbour speculative decoding); EWE runs it with 100 retrieved candidate passages.

extra_systems.name: DRAGIN
extra_systems.note: Iterative RAG that pauses when a confidence score mixing attention and entropy drops and builds a keyword query from attended tokens.

extra_systems.name: Chain-of-Verification (CoVe)
extra_systems.note: Prompting method in which the LLM verifies and revises its own draft without retrieval; EWE uses the factor+revise variant.

extra_systems.name: Act
extra_systems.note: ReAct without the reasoning (thought) steps; actions only.

extra_systems.name: Imitation learning (BUTLER / WebShop IL)
extra_systems.note: Trained imitation-learning agents whose numbers ExpeL copies from the ReAct paper (BUTLER on ALFWorld, the WebShop IL model).

extra_systems.name: Least-to-Most (agent adaptation)
extra_systems.note: Decompose into subquestions (subgoals) and solve them in order; HiAgent's 'w. TD' baseline keeps the full history.

extra_systems.name: Tree-Planner
extra_systems.note: Closed-loop LLM task planner that samples plans into an action tree; compared by HiAgent on Tyreworld.

extra_systems.name: GPT-4.1
extra_systems.note: OpenAI LLM, direct-inference baseline without tools (IterResearch Table 1).

extra_systems.name: o4-mini
extra_systems.note: OpenAI reasoning model, direct-inference baseline.

extra_systems.name: DeepSeek-R1
extra_systems.note: Reasoning LLM; variant names the checkpoint (e.g. 0528).

extra_systems.name: Perplexity Deep Research
extra_systems.note: Proprietary deep-research product (Perplexity).

extra_systems.name: Grok 3 Research (DeepSearch)
extra_systems.note: Proprietary deep-research mode of Grok 3 (xAI).

extra_systems.name: Search-o1
extra_systems.note: Agentic search-enhanced large reasoning model; variant names the backbone.

extra_systems.name: WebDancer
extra_systems.note: Autonomous information-seeking web agent.

extra_systems.name: ASearcher
extra_systems.note: Long-horizon agentic search trained with large-scale asynchronous RL.

extra_systems.name: WebSailor
extra_systems.note: Web agent trained for super-human-level information seeking; variant names model size.

extra_systems.name: MiroThinker
extra_systems.note: Open-source deep-research agent from MiroMind; variant names size and version.

extra_systems.name: Fine-tuning (edit baseline)
extra_systems.note: Gradient steps on the one fact to change, all layers or a chosen layer; knowledge-editing baseline.

extra_systems.name: Constrained fine-tuning (Zhu et al. 2020)
extra_systems.note: Modifying Memories in Transformer Models: fine-tuning with a norm constraint between original and edited parameters.

extra_systems.name: Transformer (no memory)
extra_systems.note: Plain segment-by-segment Transformer with no memory across segments; baseline in Memoria.

extra_systems.name: Transformer-XL
extra_systems.note: Segment-level recurrence: caches the previous segment's hidden states as extra keys and values.

extra_systems.name: Compressive Transformer
extra_systems.note: Transformer-XL plus a compressed memory of older activations.

extra_systems.name: ∞-former
extra_systems.note: Long-term memory as a continuous-space attention over past hidden states.

extra_systems.name: BERT
extra_systems.note: Pre-trained encoder (bert-base-uncased in Memoria), 512-token input.

extra_systems.name: RoBERTa
extra_systems.note: Pre-trained encoder (base), 512-token input.

extra_systems.name: BigBird
extra_systems.note: Sparse-attention encoder, 4,096-token input.

extra_systems.name: Longformer
extra_systems.note: Sliding-window plus global attention encoder, 4,096-token input.

extra_systems.name: GPT-2
extra_systems.note: Pre-trained decoder (small, large, XL) fine-tuned without memory; baseline in Memoria Table 8.

extra_systems.name: Search-R1
extra_systems.note: LLM trained with RL to interleave reasoning and search calls, ReAct-style history.

extra_systems.name: AutoRefine
extra_systems.note: RL-trained search agent that refines retrieved evidence during thinking.

extra_systems.name: ReSearch
extra_systems.note: RL-trained model that reasons with search, keeping the full interaction history.

extra_systems.name: ZeroSearch
extra_systems.note: RL training of search agents with a simulated search engine.

extra_systems.name: O2-Searcher
extra_systems.note: Search-based agent for open-domain open-ended QA.

extra_systems.name: R1-Searcher
extra_systems.note: Two-stage RL training that incentivises search during reasoning.

extra_systems.name: Standard (no strategy planning)
extra_systems.note: Dialogue agent LLM prompted to reply without any explicit strategy; the base row in PRINCIPLES Table 1.

extra_systems.name: Proactive
extra_systems.note: Deng et al. 2023: prompt the LLM to pick the next strategy from a pre-defined set before replying.

extra_systems.name: ProCoT
extra_systems.note: Deng et al. 2023: chain-of-thought analysis of the dialogue, then a pre-defined strategy.

extra_systems.name: PPDPP
extra_systems.note: Plug-and-play policy planner (Deng et al. 2024): small LM planner trained by SFT on labelled strategies and RL from self-play AI feedback.

extra_systems.name: Ask-an-Expert (AnE)
extra_systems.note: Zhang et al. 2023: an LLM acting as expert infers the user's state and writes an open-ended strategy.

extra_systems.name: ICL-AIF
extra_systems.note: Fu et al. 2023: open-ended strategy suggestions from iterative AI feedback in self-play.

extra_systems.name: DPDP
extra_systems.note: He et al. 2024: dual-process dialogue planning with MCTS-based strategy selection.

extra_systems.name: GPT-4
extra_systems.note: The LLM used directly, one sample per problem, no memory or retries (code baseline in Reflexion).

extra_systems.name: CodeT
extra_systems.note: Code generation that scores sampled programs with model-generated tests; no memory.

extra_systems.name: Chain-of-Thought
extra_systems.note: Step-by-step prompting without tools or memory; in Reflexion's CoT (GT) variant the gold context is given.

extra_systems.name: OpenClaw (vanilla)
extra_systems.note: Open agent harness used as the unmanaged baseline in TokenPilot: built-in compaction only (500k window, trigger ratio 0.5).

extra_systems.name: LLMLingua-2
extra_systems.note: Token-level prompt compression with a small model (Findings of ACL 2024); TokenPilot used compression ratio 0.6.

extra_systems.name: Selective Context
extra_systems.note: Self-information-based pruning of low-information text (EMNLP 2023); TokenPilot used ratio 0.4.

extra_systems.name: LCM (Lossless Context Management)
extra_systems.note: Hierarchical-summary compaction with retained recent turns (Voltropy technical report, 2026).

extra_systems.name: Pichay
extra_systems.note: Demand paging for LLM context windows: utility-driven eviction of old tool results.

extra_systems.name: Summary (hierarchical compaction)
extra_systems.note: Generic baseline in TokenPilot: history compressed into hierarchical summaries at 40% of a 500k window.

extra_systems.name: MemoBrain
extra_systems.note: Executive memory for agent reasoning with a memory budget and recall.

extra_systems.name: AgentSwing
extra_systems.note: Adaptive context-management routing (discard-all, keep-last-n, summary) for long-horizon web agents.

extra_systems.name: Keep-Last-N
extra_systems.note: Generic baseline: keep only the most recent N turns once context passes a threshold (N = 5 in TokenPilot).

extra_systems.name: FT-L
extra_systems.note: Fine-tuning one MLP layer with a norm constraint, in ROME's reimplementation (WISE adds a KL term).

extra_systems.name: FT-EWC
extra_systems.note: Fine-tuning with Elastic Weight Consolidation, as reimplemented in GRACE.

extra_systems.name: MEND
extra_systems.note: Hypernetwork that turns fine-tuning gradients into low-rank weight edits.

extra_systems.name: ROME
extra_systems.note: Locate-then-edit: rank-one update to one mid-layer MLP found by causal tracing.

extra_systems.name: MEMIT
extra_systems.note: Locate-then-edit over several MLP layers with a least-squares update; MEMIT-MASS is its batch mode.

extra_systems.name: DEFER
extra_systems.note: GRACE's reimplementation of SERAC-style routing: a scope classifier plus a small linear counterfactual model.

extra_systems.name: GRACE
extra_systems.note: Lifelong editing with a discrete key-value codebook that replaces one layer's activation when a key is within its radius.

extra_systems.name: Unedited model
extra_systems.note: The base model before any edit (reported as 'w/o Editing' or 'Pre-edited').

extra_systems.name: Generative Agents
extra_systems.note: Park et al. (2023): memory stream retrieved by a weighted sum of min-max-normalised recency, importance and relevance.

extra_systems.name: All memories in context
extra_systems.note: Generic baseline: every stored memory is put in the context with no retrieval (EMG-RAG's NiaH, THEANINE's 'All Memories').

extra_systems.name: M-RAG
extra_systems.note: RAG over multiple database partitions with multi-agent RL (ACL 2024): Agent-S picks a partition, Agent-R refines memories.

extra_systems.name: Keqing
extra_systems.note: Knowledge-graph QA that splits a question into sub-questions, retrieves candidate entities, answers each and merges the answers.

extra_systems.name: Direct inference
extra_systems.note: The LLM answers the question directly, with no retrieval, tools or memory; search-agent baseline as in Search-R1.

extra_systems.name: SFT (search-agent baseline)
extra_systems.note: Supervised fine-tuning on question-answer data without search, as the SFT baseline in Search-R1's QA tables.

extra_systems.name: R1 (RL without search)
extra_systems.note: DeepSeek-R1-style RL on the QA training data, reasoning and answering without a search engine; variant names base or instruct start.

extra_systems.name: Rejection sampling
extra_systems.note: Fine-tuning on the model's own sampled trajectories that reached the correct answer, with search; Search-R1 QA baseline.

extra_systems.name: Contriever
extra_systems.note: Unsupervised dense bi-encoder retriever trained with contrastive learning; used as a plain passage retriever baseline.

extra_systems.name: GTR
extra_systems.note: Generalizable T5-based dense bi-encoder retriever; plain passage retriever baseline.

extra_systems.name: ColBERTv2
extra_systems.note: Late-interaction (token-level MaxSim) passage retriever; plain passage retriever baseline.

extra_systems.name: Proposition (Dense X)
extra_systems.note: Passages rewritten by an LLM into atomic propositions that are indexed and retrieved instead of passages; variant names the retriever.

extra_systems.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill (generic reasoner)
extra_systems.note: DeepSeek-R1-distilled Llama/Qwen models used as a generic long-CoT reasoning baseline without user history.

extra_systems.name: OPPU
extra_systems.note: One PEFT Per User (Tan et al., 2024): per-user LoRA personalization, trained on other users' history first.

extra_systems.name: KV-Mem
extra_systems.note: Key-value memory networks (Miller et al., 2016); KGQA baseline.

extra_systems.name: EmbedKGQA
extra_systems.note: KG-embedding-based multi-hop KGQA (Saxena et al., ACL 2020).

extra_systems.name: NSM
extra_systems.note: Neural State Machine KGQA with teacher-student intermediate supervision (He et al., WSDM 2021).

extra_systems.name: TransferNet
extra_systems.note: Transparent multi-hop KGQA over relation graphs (Shi et al., EMNLP 2021).

extra_systems.name: KGT5
extra_systems.note: Sequence-to-sequence KG completion and QA (Saxena et al., ACL 2022).

extra_systems.name: GraftNet
extra_systems.note: Early fusion of KB and text with graph propagation (Sun et al., EMNLP 2018).

extra_systems.name: PullNet
extra_systems.note: Iterative question-specific subgraph retrieval with GCNs (Sun et al., EMNLP 2019).

extra_systems.name: SR (Subgraph Retriever)
extra_systems.note: Trainable subgraph retriever decoupled from the reasoner (Zhang et al., ACL 2022); reported as SR+NSM.

extra_systems.name: KD-CoT
extra_systems.note: Knowledge-driven chain-of-thought verified against a KG (Wang et al., arXiv preprint).

extra_systems.name: UniKGQA
extra_systems.note: Unified retrieval and reasoning for multi-hop KGQA (Jiang et al., ICLR 2023).

extra_systems.name: KG-CoT
extra_systems.note: Chain-of-thought over KGs with a small graph reasoning model (Zhao et al., IJCAI 2024).

extra_systems.name: SubgraphRAG
extra_systems.note: Lightweight MLP with parallel triple scoring for subgraph retrieval, then an LLM reasons (Li et al., ICLR 2025).

extra_systems.name: AWM (Agent Workflow Memory)
extra_systems.note: Induces reusable workflows from past trajectories and adds them to the agent's memory (as described in Skill-Pro §5.1).

extra_systems.name: MindAct
extra_systems.note: Mind2Web's baseline agent: element ranker top-50 then LLM multi-choice action selection.

extra_systems.name: RCI
extra_systems.note: Recursively Criticizes and Improves: LLM plan + self-correction on MiniWoB++ (Kim et al., NeurIPS 2023).

extra_systems.name: AdaPlanner
extra_systems.note: Adaptive planning from environment feedback (Sun et al., 2023).

extra_systems.name: Pix2Act
extra_systems.note: Pixel-based agent trained with BC and tree search (Shaw et al., 2023).

extra_systems.name: CC-Net
extra_systems.note: BC + RL on 2.4M MiniWoB++ demonstrations (Humphreys et al., ICML 2022).

extra_systems.name: WebGUM
extra_systems.note: Multimodal fine-tuned web agent (Furuta et al., 2023).

extra_systems.name: WebN-T5
extra_systems.note: T5 fine-tuned on 12k MiniWoB++ demonstrations (Gur et al., 2023).

extra_systems.name: Prior MiniWoB++ methods (aggregate)
extra_systems.note: 'Others' column of Synapse Table 3: aggregated baselines before CC-Net (Shi et al. 2017; Liu et al. 2018; Gur et al. 2018; Jia et al. 2018).

extra_systems.name: Memory Retrieval (MSC)
extra_systems.note: Retrieval of the k most similar summarized memory sentences for response generation (Xu et al., 2022, Beyond Goldfish Memory); k=6 in THEANINE.

extra_systems.name: COMEDY
extra_systems.note: Compress to Impress: LLM summarizes sessions and compresses them into events, user portrait and user-bot relation for response generation.

extra_systems.name: In-context learning (many-shot)
extra_systems.note: Task demonstrations from the training split placed in the prompt, all of them or as many as fit the context window (ACE §4.2).

extra_systems.name: GEPA
extra_systems.note: Reflective prompt optimiser: collects execution traces, reflects in natural language and evolves prompts with a genetic Pareto search; run via DSPy with auto="heavy" in ACE.

extra_systems.name: MIPROv2
extra_systems.note: DSPy prompt optimiser that jointly tunes instructions and few-shot demonstrations by Bayesian optimisation.

extra_systems.name: Dynamic Cheatsheet (DC)
extra_systems.note: Test-time memory of reusable strategies and code snippets that an LLM rewrites after each input; ACE runs the cumulative mode (DC-CU).

extra_systems.name: LightRAG
extra_systems.note: Graph-based RAG with LLM-extracted entities and relations and dual-level (entity and relation) retrieval combined with chunks.

extra_systems.name: PathRAG
extra_systems.note: Graph RAG on the same entity-relation graph as LightRAG that retrieves relational paths and prunes them (as summarised in HyperGraphRAG Table 1 and App. F).

extra_systems.name: Stella (stella_en_1.5B_v5)
extra_systems.note: Dense text embedding model distilled from larger embedders (Jasper and Stella).

extra_systems.name: BGE-M3
extra_systems.note: Multilingual, multi-granularity dense embedding model (Chen et al., 2024).

extra_systems.name: LongMemEval RAG pipeline
extra_systems.note: Retrieval-augmented memory design from the LongMemEval paper, as used by Associa: Stella retriever with user facts concatenated to keys (UF), optional LLM time filtering (TF), and Chain-of-Note reading in JSON format.

extra_systems.name: Buy and hold
extra_systems.note: Passive trading baseline: buy the stock at the start of the test period and keep it.

extra_systems.name: FinGPT
extra_systems.note: Open-source financial LLM framework (Yang et al., 2023) used as an LLM trading-agent baseline.

extra_systems.name: A2C (DRL trading agent)
extra_systems.note: Advantage actor-critic deep-RL trading agent on numeric market features (Stable-Baselines3).

extra_systems.name: PPO (DRL trading agent)
extra_systems.note: Proximal policy optimization deep-RL trading agent on numeric market features (Stable-Baselines3).

extra_systems.name: DQN (DRL trading agent)
extra_systems.note: Deep Q-network trading agent on numeric market features (Stable-Baselines3).

extra_systems.name: Router-KNN
extra_systems.note: LLM router that assigns a query to the LLM favoured by its nearest neighbours in embedding space (Shnitzer et al., 2023).

extra_systems.name: Router-MLP
extra_systems.note: MLP router over query embeddings (Shnitzer et al., 2023).

extra_systems.name: Router-SVM
extra_systems.note: SVM router over query features, from RouterBench (Hu et al., 2024).

extra_systems.name: RouterDC
extra_systems.note: Query-based LLM router trained with dual contrastive learning (Chen et al., NeurIPS 2024).

extra_systems.name: GraphRouter
extra_systems.note: Single-round LLM router posed as edge prediction on a query-task-LLM graph (Feng et al., 2024).

extra_systems.name: Prompt LLM (router)
extra_systems.note: Baseline from Router-R1: an LLM prompted to pick LLMs over several rounds, no routing module.

extra_systems.name: Router-KNN-MR
extra_systems.note: Multi-round extension of Router-KNN, from Router-R1.

extra_systems.name: R2-Reasoner
extra_systems.note: Route-and-Reason: a reinforced model router that decomposes a task and routes sub-tasks (Shao et al., 2025).

extra_systems.name: Router-R1
extra_systems.note: LLM router trained with RL to interleave thinking and routing over several rounds (Zhang, Feng, You, 2025).

extra_systems.name: ALBERT
extra_systems.note: 'A lite BERT' encoder; fine-tuned PLM baseline for temporal KGQA (MemoTime ref [21]).

extra_systems.name: CronKGQA
extra_systems.note: Embedding-based temporal KGQA that aligns question embeddings with time-stamped triples (Saxena et al., ACL 2021; MemoTime ref [36]).

extra_systems.name: MultiQA
extra_systems.note: Embedding-based multi-granularity temporal KGQA from the MultiTQ paper (Chen et al., ACL 2023; MemoTime ref [5]).

extra_systems.name: ChatGPT (GPT-3.5-Turbo)
extra_systems.note: GPT-3.5-Turbo prompted directly, as reported in temporal KGQA papers.

extra_systems.name: KG-RAG (temporal KGQA baseline)
extra_systems.note: LLM in-context baseline combining a temporal KG with GPT-3.5-Turbo, as reported in the ARI paper (MemoTime ref [4]).

extra_systems.name: ReAct KB
extra_systems.note: ReAct-style agent over a temporal KG with GPT-3.5-Turbo, as reported in the ARI paper (MemoTime ref [4]).

extra_systems.name: ARI
extra_systems.note: Abstract reasoning induction for temporal KGQA with GPT-3.5-Turbo (Chen et al., ACL 2024; MemoTime ref [4]).

extra_systems.name: TempAgent
extra_systems.note: Time-aware ReAct agent for temporal KGQA with GPT-3.5-Turbo (Hu et al., Findings of NAACL 2025; MemoTime ref [13]).

extra_systems.name: UNIQORN
extra_systems.note: Unified QA over RDF knowledge graphs and text (Pramanik et al., Journal of Web Semantics 2024; MemoTime ref [34]).

extra_systems.name: TempoQR
extra_systems.note: Temporal question reasoning over KGs with embeddings (Mavromatis et al., AAAI 2022; MemoTime ref [28]).

extra_systems.name: EXAQT
extra_systems.note: Complex temporal QA on KGs; the paper that introduced TimeQuestions (Jia et al., CIKM 2021; MemoTime ref [18]).

extra_systems.name: TwiRGCN
extra_systems.note: Temporally weighted graph convolution for temporal KGQA (Sharma et al.; MemoTime ref [38]).

extra_systems.name: LGQA
extra_systems.note: Local and global information fusion for temporal QA (Liu et al., IJCAI 2023; MemoTime ref [25]).

extra_systems.name: GenTKGQA
extra_systems.note: Two-stage generative temporal KGQA that fine-tunes LLaMA2-7B (Gao et al., ACL 2024; MemoTime ref [11]).

extra_systems.name: TimeR4
extra_systems.note: Time-aware RAG for temporal KGQA: a jointly fine-tuned retriever feeding ChatGPT (Qian et al., EMNLP 2024; MemoTime ref [35]).

extra_systems.name: Random history items
extra_systems.note: Personalization baseline that puts k randomly chosen documents from the user's history into the prompt.

extra_systems.name: Most recent history items
extra_systems.note: Personalization baseline that puts the user's k most recent documents into the prompt.

extra_systems.name: ROPG
extra_systems.note: Retrieval optimization for personalized generation (Salemi et al., SIGIR 2024): retriever trained from feedback on LLM generations.

extra_systems.name: CFRAG
extra_systems.note: RAG with collaborative filtering for personalized text generation (Shi et al., SIGIR 2025): also retrieves from similar users' histories.

extra_systems.name: Memory-R1
extra_systems.note: LLM agents trained with reinforcement learning to manage and use an external memory (arXiv 2508.19828).

extra_systems.name: SPARQA
extra_systems.note: Skeleton-based semantic parsing for complex KBQA (Sun et al., AAAI 2020); listed as 'SPARQL' in RoG Table 1.

extra_systems.name: QGG
extra_systems.note: Query graph generation for multi-hop complex KBQA (Lan & Jiang, ACL 2020).

extra_systems.name: ArcaneQA
extra_systems.note: Dynamic program induction and contextualized encoding for KBQA (Gu & Su, COLING 2022).

extra_systems.name: RnG-KBQA
extra_systems.note: Generation-augmented iterative ranking of logical forms for KBQA (Ye et al., ACL 2022).

extra_systems.name: DECAF
extra_systems.note: Joint decoding of answers and logical forms for KBQA (Yu et al., ICLR 2023); RoG reports the DPR+FiD-3B variant.

extra_systems.name: Oracle messages
extra_systems.note: Reference, not a system: the gold evidence messages are given to the answer model, so only generation is tested.

extra_systems.name: Self-Consistency (CoT-SC)
extra_systems.note: Sample several chain-of-thought answers and take the majority (Wang et al., ICLR 2023); no external knowledge.

extra_systems.name: Prior fine-tuned SOTA
extra_systems.note: Placeholder for the best previously published fine-tuned result on each dataset as cited by Think-on-Graph Table 1; a different system per dataset (named in the row variant).

extra_systems.name: KB-BINDER
extra_systems.note: Few-shot in-context KBQA: Codex drafts logical forms that are bound to the KB (Li et al., ACL 2023).

extra_systems.name: CBR-KBQA
extra_systems.note: Case-based reasoning for KBQA: retrieves similar solved questions and adapts their logical forms (Das et al., 2021).

extra_systems.name: TIARA
extra_systems.note: Multi-grained retrieval of KB items to guide logical-form generation (Shu et al., EMNLP 2022).

extra_systems.name: StructGPT
extra_systems.note: Prompting framework in which the LLM reads structured data through interface calls (Jiang et al., 2023).

extra_systems.name: STM
extra_systems.note: Space-Time Memory network for video object segmentation: every memory frame is kept and read by attention (Oh et al., ICCV 2019).

extra_systems.name: STCN
extra_systems.note: Space-time correspondence network with L2 similarity and shared keys (Cheng et al., NeurIPS 2021); XMem's working-memory baseline.

extra_systems.name: AOT
extra_systems.note: Associating Objects with Transformers for VOS (Yang et al., NeurIPS 2021); XMem compares the R50 variant.

extra_systems.name: CFBI
extra_systems.note: Collaborative foreground-background integration VOS (Yang et al., ECCV 2020); temporally local memory.

extra_systems.name: CFBI+
extra_systems.note: Multi-scale CFBI (Yang et al., TPAMI 2021).

extra_systems.name: RMNet
extra_systems.note: Efficient regional memory network for VOS (Xie et al., CVPR 2021).

extra_systems.name: HMMN
extra_systems.note: Hierarchical memory matching network for VOS (Seong et al., ICCV 2021).

extra_systems.name: MiVOS
extra_systems.note: Modular interactive VOS with propagation and fusion modules (Cheng et al., CVPR 2021); evaluated with BL30K pretraining.

extra_systems.name: JOINT
extra_systems.note: Joint inductive and transductive learning for VOS with a local memory window (Mao et al., ICCV 2021).

extra_systems.name: AFB-URR
extra_systems.note: Adaptive feature bank that merges similar features and evicts least-used ones, for long videos (Liang et al., NeurIPS 2020).

extra_systems.name: GEAR
extra_systems.note: Graph-based evidence aggregating and reasoning for fact verification (Zhou et al., 2019); SimGRAG uses its KG version trained on FactKG.

extra_systems.name: KELP
extra_systems.note: KG-enhanced LLMs via a trained path-selection model (Liu et al., 2024); 1- or 2-hop paths from oracle entities.

extra_systems.name: G-Retriever
extra_systems.note: Retrieves similar nodes and relations, builds a prize-collecting Steiner tree subgraph and encodes it with a GNN for a frozen LLM (He et al., 2024).

extra_systems.name: KAPING
extra_systems.note: Knowledge-augmented LM prompting: retrieves KG triples by embedding similarity to the question and prompts zero-shot (Baek et al., NLRSE workshop 2023).

extra_systems.name: KG-GPT
extra_systems.note: Segments the query and lets an LLM pick matching KG relations per segment, starting from given entities (Kim et al., 2023).

extra_systems.name: CAD (context-aware decoding)
extra_systems.note: Contrastive decoding that amplifies the difference between output distributions with and without the retrieved context (Shi et al., NAACL 2024).

extra_systems.name: AdaCAD
extra_systems.note: Context-aware decoding whose contrast weight adapts to the measured conflict between context and parametric knowledge (Han et al., NAACL 2025).

extra_systems.name: Adaptive-RAG
extra_systems.note: A trained classifier predicts question complexity and chooses the retrieval strategy (Jeong et al., NAACL 2024); CARE uses a binary retrieve / no-retrieve variant.

extra_systems.name: SKR-kNN
extra_systems.note: Self-knowledge guided retrieval: kNN over embeddings of training questions the LLM got right or wrong without retrieval decides whether to retrieve (Wang et al., EMNLP 2023).

extra_systems.name: Priori Judgment
extra_systems.note: The LLM is prompted to say whether it can answer (with the passage shown); 'unknown' falls back to the closed-book answer (Ren et al., COLING 2025).

extra_systems.name: RetRobust
extra_systems.note: Fine-tunes the LLM with irrelevant and distracting retrieved contexts so it learns to ignore them (Yoran et al., ICLR 2024).

extra_systems.name: Direct FT (conflict-aware fine-tuning of the LLM)
extra_systems.note: Baseline built in the CARE paper: CARE's positive / hard-negative training applied to the base LLM with LoRA instead of a context assessor.

extra_systems.name: Instruct model, prompted
extra_systems.note: The instruction-tuned base model used zero-shot as the agent, with no training on the environment ('Prompt' rows in Early Experience).

extra_systems.name: Imitation learning (SFT on expert trajectories)
extra_systems.note: Behaviour cloning: next-token SFT of the same base model on expert (state, action) pairs; the IL baseline in Early Experience, with the same step budget.

extra_systems.name: STaR-style rationales
extra_systems.note: Zelikman et al. (2022): fine-tune on model-written rationales for the expert action, without looking at alternative actions or their outcomes.

extra_systems.name: DPO
extra_systems.note: Direct Preference Optimization (Rafailov et al., 2023); in Early Experience the expert action is 'chosen' and a rolled-out non-expert action 'rejected'.

extra_systems.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
extra_systems.note: Proprietary LLM prompted as an agent; Early Experience copies its ALFWorld and WebShop numbers from Feng et al. (2025).

extra_systems.name: GPT-4-Turbo
extra_systems.note: Proprietary LLM prompted as a web agent; Early Experience copies its WebArena-Lite number from Qi et al. (2025).

extra_systems.name: Reset (train from scratch)
extra_systems.note: Continual-RL baseline: re-initialise the network at every new task (DQN-Reset / SAC 'independent' in FAME); reference for forward transfer.

extra_systems.name: Finetune
extra_systems.note: Continual-RL baseline: keep training the same network from task to task with no protection against forgetting.

extra_systems.name: Average (TD-target averaging)
extra_systems.note: FAME's Meta-World baseline: the critic's TD target is averaged over the agents of all past tasks.

extra_systems.name: DQN MultiHead
extra_systems.note: DQN with one output head per task, given the task identity (baseline from Anand & Precup, 2023).

extra_systems.name: DQN LargeBuffer
extra_systems.note: DQN with a larger replay buffer that keeps past-task data (500k transitions in FAME's code).

extra_systems.name: PT-DQN
extra_systems.note: Permanent + transient value functions (Anand & Precup, NeurIPS 2023): a slow permanent network plus a fast transient one per task.

extra_systems.name: PackNet
extra_systems.note: Mallya & Lazebnik (CVPR 2018): prunes and freezes a subset of weights per task; zero forgetting, needs task identity.

extra_systems.name: Progressive Networks
extra_systems.note: Rusu et al. (2016): adds a new column per task with lateral connections to frozen earlier columns.

extra_systems.name: CompoNet
extra_systems.note: Self-composing policies (Malagon et al., ICML 2024): a growing set of policy modules combined by attention.

extra_systems.name: RMT (Recurrent Memory Transformer)
extra_systems.note: Segment-level recurrence through memory tokens written by a forward pass; two-segment version in GradMem.

extra_systems.name: ARMT (Associative Recurrent Memory Transformer)
extra_systems.note: RMT with per-layer associative memory matrices updated DeltaNet-style.

extra_systems.name: Mamba / Mamba-2
extra_systems.note: Selective state-space sequence model; its recurrent state acts as memory. GradMem uses Mamba-2 (130M) and a 4-layer version.

extra_systems.name: Pythia
extra_systems.note: Pretrained decoder LM suite; Pythia-160m fine-tuned with full context as an upper bound in GradMem.

extra_systems.name: UI-TARS
extra_systems.note: Native GUI agent model (7B and 72B rows in SE-GA). SE-GA cites the UI-TARS-2 technical report (arXiv 2509.02544) for it.

extra_systems.name: Qwen2.5-VL
extra_systems.note: Open vision-language model; 7B and 72B rows; SE-GA's base model.

extra_systems.name: Aria-UI
extra_systems.note: GUI grounding model (23B per SE-GA Table 1).

extra_systems.name: SeeClick
extra_systems.note: GUI grounding agent (9.6B); also introduced ScreenSpot.

extra_systems.name: UGround
extra_systems.note: GUI grounding baseline (7B). SE-GA cites arXiv 2510.03853 for it and also lists Gou et al., arXiv 2410.05243 ('universal visual grounding for GUI agents') in its references.

extra_systems.name: OS-Atlas
extra_systems.note: Foundation action model for GUI agents (7B).

extra_systems.name: Aguvis
extra_systems.note: Pure-vision GUI agent (7B).

extra_systems.name: OS-Genesis
extra_systems.note: GUI agent trained on reverse-synthesised trajectories (7B).

extra_systems.name: GUI-Critic-R1
extra_systems.note: Pre-operative error-diagnosis critic for GUI automation (7B row on AndroidWorld).

extra_systems.name: Claude 3 Opus (as named by SE-GA)
extra_systems.note: SE-GA §5.2 names the baseline Claude3-Opus but cites Anthropic's 2024 'Our 3.5 models and computer use' post; the tables just say Claude.

extra_systems.name: Video-LLaVA
extra_systems.note: Open video LVLM (7B); baseline host model in Video-RAG Table 1.

extra_systems.name: Long-LLaVA (aws-prototyping/long-llava-qwen2-7b)
extra_systems.note: The Hugging Face model cited as [45] in Video-RAG, not the LongLLaVA hybrid-architecture paper (arXiv 2409.02889).

extra_systems.name: VITA-1.5
extra_systems.note: Open omni-modal LVLM; row in Video-RAG Table 1.

extra_systems.name: Video-XL
extra_systems.note: Long-video LVLM; row in Video-RAG Table 2 (MLVU).

extra_systems.name: Aria
extra_systems.note: Open multimodal mixture-of-experts model; row in Video-RAG Tables 2-3.

extra_systems.name: Oryx MLLM
extra_systems.note: Row in Video-RAG Table 2 (MLVU).

extra_systems.name: PLLaVA
extra_systems.note: Row in Video-RAG Table 3 (LongVideoBench).

extra_systems.name: ShareGPT4Video
extra_systems.note: Row in Video-RAG Table 3 (LongVideoBench).

extra_systems.name: LLaVA-NeXT (Mistral-7B)
extra_systems.note: Image LVLM; row in Video-RAG Table 3.

extra_systems.name: VideoChat2 (Mistral-7B)
extra_systems.note: Row in Video-RAG Table 3; the paper gives no reference for it (only VideoChat, arXiv 2305.06355, is cited).

extra_systems.name: Orca
extra_systems.note: LLM serving system with iteration-level scheduling (OSDI 2022). Not public; vLLM compares against its own reimplementation in three reservation variants (Max, Pow2, Oracle).

ZsRE, 1000 sequential edits, Mistral-7B. Scores x100 from the paper's 0-1 values. Overall = AVG of REL, GEN, LOC (Table 3). Locality prompts from NQ (§4.3). Edits are appended to the question as 'It is or they are X' inside ({USER_ST})...({USER_END}), written to memory by the write model, and read back with a 5-shot QA prompt whose last shot shows a memory read (§4.3). Released eval script scores reliability as 'edit string contained in the generated answer' (eval_zsre.py L246), a different measure from the copied baselines; it also evaluates each edit right after writing it, with only earlier edits in memory (L237-L250), and gather_zsre_result.py drops prompts containing 'sex' or 'gender'. Thresholds per App. D: tau_e 0.85, tau_t 0.2, tau_r 0.6 (code: REL_SIM 0.5).

Self-play simulation: an LLM user simulator and an LLM critic (both gpt-4o, §3.3) play out each test episode for up to 10 turns; the critic's verbal verdict is sampled 10 times (temperature 1.0), mapped to [-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1] and averaged, and an episode succeeds when the mean exceeds 0.5 (App. F.1). Score = success rate x 100. Agent replies without explicit strategy planning; the row label '+ GPT-3.5-Turbo' is read as the agent backbone. Average turns 8.59. The paper reimplements the baselines with its own prompts (App. F.2) but does not say explicitly whether any number was copied.

results.variant: LoCoMo baseline (Maharana et al. 2024), full conversation in context
results.notes: CHECK: token-cost column (16,910) identical to A-Mem v1 (arXiv 2502.12110v1) Table 1 GPT-4o-mini 'LoCoMo' row; 1/8 F1/BLEU values coincide position-wise. Paper says the LoCoMo evaluation set has '1,986 questions categorized into four distinct reasoning types' (Sec 3.1, App. B.1): 1,986 is the full 5-category count, but only 4 categories are reported, so the exact question subset is unclear. Baselines: 'we instantiate each baseline and SimpleMem on multiple LLM backends' (Sec 3.1). SimpleMem uses Qwen3-embedding-0.6b + BM25 + metadata, adaptive k in [3,20], memory built by gpt-4.1-mini (Table 7). Token cost per query is in the table (not transcribed as rows).

LoCoMo, 10 conversations, 1,540 questions in four categories (adversarial excluded, §4.1.1). Accuracy judged CORRECT/WRONG by GPT-4o-mini with the judge prompt the paper attributes to Nemori (App. A), same prompt for all methods (§4.1.3). Scores are success rates (paper Eq. 9); EasyEdit computes them as teacher-forced token accuracy ('token em'). Random-prefix augmentation applied to all methods (§3.1). Edit set: random 1K sample of the ZsRE test split (MEND split); locality prompts are NQ questions.

tax.unique: Four years of privacy-preserving images/videos/emails; Schema-Guided Memory structurally represents multi-source items.

papers.title: AMemGym: Interactive Memory Benchmarking for Assistants in Long-Horizon Conversations

tax.name: AMemGym
tax.what: An interactive environment with LLM-simulated users and predefined profiles enables on-policy evaluation and optimization of memory-driven personalization in long dialogues.
tax.unique: Interactive on-policy environment with LLM-simulated users enables live optimization, not static transcripts.

papers.title: The Price of Meaning: Why Every Semantic Memory System Forgets

tax.name: The Price of Meaning
tax.what: Formally proves that semantic memory's finite effective rank forces interference-driven forgetting and false recall, then tests the prediction across five memory architectures.

papers.title: Evoking User Memory: Personalizing LLM via Recollection-Familiarity Adaptive Retrieval

tax.name: RF-Mem
tax.what: Familiarity score/entropy routes queries to fast top-K similarity retrieval or, when uncertain, to iterative cluster-expansion recollection in embedding space.
tax.learns_what: nothing; fixed familiarity/recollection dual-path retrieval heuristic
tax.unique: Familiarity score and entropy route queries to fast top-K retrieval or iterative cluster-expansion recollection in embedding space.

papers.title: PlugMem: A Task-Agnostic Plugin Memory Module for LLM Agents

tax.name: PlugMem
tax.what: Episodic memories are structured into a compact knowledge-centric memory graph of propositional/prescriptive knowledge, retrieved and reasoned over instead of raw trajectories.
tax.learns_what: nothing; fixed knowledge-centric memory graph construction and retrieval
tax.unique: Structures episodic memory as propositional/prescriptive knowledge units instead of entities, unlike other graph methods.

papers.title: FluxMem: Adaptive Hierarchical Memory for Streaming Video Understanding

sources.section: Papers - Nonparametric Memory / Multimodal Memory (for Understanding)

tax.name: FluxMem
tax.what: Removes redundant visual tokens across adjacent frames (temporal) then merges repetitive regions within a frame (spatial) with self-adaptive compression rates.
tax.learns_what: nothing; training-free adaptive visual token compression from scene statistics
tax.unique: Two-stage temporal-then-spatial token pruning with a self-adaptive rate set from scene statistics, no training.

papers.title: LoGeR: Long-Context Geometric Reconstruction with Hybrid Memory

sources.section: Papers - Nonparametric Memory / Multimodal Memory (for Generation)

tax.name: LoGeR
tax.what: A parametric test-time-training memory anchors the global coordinate frame across video chunks while a non-parametric sliding-window attention preserves local high-fidelity context.
tax.learns_what: hybrid memory (parametric TTT plus sliding-window attention) trained end-to-end for chunked reconstruction
tax.unique: Parametric TTT memory anchors the global coordinate frame across video chunks; sliding-window attention keeps local context.

papers.title: GradMem: Learning to Write Context into Memory with Test-Time Gradient Descent

tax.name: GradMem
tax.what: A few steps of per-sample gradient descent write context into a small set of frozen-weight prefix memory tokens via a reconstruction loss, read back at query time.
tax.learns_what: nothing persists across tasks; fixed per-sample test-time gradient descent writes memory tokens
tax.unique: Per-sample gradient descent on frozen weights writes context into prefix memory tokens via a reconstruction loss.

papers.title: OpenClaw-RL: Train Any Agent Simply by Talking

sources.section: Papers - Memory for Agent Evolution / Reinforcement Learning & Continual Learning

tax.name: OpenClaw-RL
tax.what: User replies, tool outputs and state changes are recovered online as evaluative/directive RL signals that update the agent policy so it improves from being used.
tax.learns_what: agent policy trained online via RL from next-state signals (user replies, tool output)
tax.unique: Recovers user replies/tool output as live evaluative and directive RL signals from real usage.

papers.title: Memento-Skills: Let Agents Design Agents

sources.section: Papers - Memory for Agent Evolution / Reinforcement Learning & Continual Learning

tax.name: Memento-Skills
tax.what: Reusable skills stored as structured markdown files are read by a trained router and written/expanded by the agent after each task via Read-Write Reflective Learning.
tax.learns_what: skill library (markdown skills) and router selection refined without any weight updates
tax.unique: A trained router reads markdown skills; the agent writes/expands its own skill library via Read-Write Reflective Learning.

papers.title: Principled Fast and Meta Knowledge Learners for Continual Reinforcement Learning

sources.section: Papers - Memory for Agent Evolution / Reinforcement Learning & Continual Learning

tax.name: FAME
tax.what: A fast learner transfers knowledge while a meta learner incrementally integrates new experience into shared parameters by explicitly minimizing catastrophic forgetting.
tax.fit: Primarily a continual-RL dual-learner architecture inspired by hippocampus-cortex interplay rather than an explicit external or parametric memory store for agents.
tax.learns_what: fast and meta learners' parameters updated via continual RL, minimizing catastrophic forgetting
tax.unique: Fast learner transfers knowledge while a meta learner integrates experience by explicitly minimizing forgetting.

papers.title: AVO: Agentic Variation Operators for Autonomous Evolutionary Search

sources.section: Papers - Memory for Agent Evolution / Reinforcement Learning & Continual Learning

tax.name: AVO
tax.what: Coding agents act as evolutionary variation operators, consulting a lineage and knowledge base to propose/repair/verify GPU kernel edits over days of autonomous search.

papers.title: Why the Brain Consolidates: Predictive Forgetting for Optimal Generalisation

sources.section: Papers - Memory for Agent Evolution / Reinforcement Learning & Continual Learning

tax.name: Why the Brain Consolidates
tax.what: Proposes that neocortical consolidation performs predictive forgetting, retaining only information that predicts future outcomes, validated via information-theoretic bounds and simulations.
tax.unique: Proposes consolidation performs predictive forgetting, retaining only information that predicts future outcomes; validated via simulations.

papers.title: A Subgoal-driven Framework for Improving Long-Horizon LLM Agents

tax.name: Subgoal-driven Framework
tax.what: An online planner decomposes goals into subgoals for real-time execution, paired with MiRA, an RL framework using dense milestone-based rewards.
tax.learns_what: policy for subgoal-conditioned long-horizon action selection

papers.title: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents in the Second Half: A Survey

tax.name: Rethinking Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents Survey
tax.what: Organizes agent memory along substrate, cognitive mechanism, and subject axes, and surveys learned policies for context curation, consolidation and skill sharing.
tax.unique: Organizes memory by substrate, cognitive mechanism and subject, highlighting reinforcement-learned context curation as trainable.

papers.title: Anatomy of Agentic Memory: Taxonomy and Empirical Analysis of Evaluation and System Limitations

tax.name: Anatomy of Agentic Memory Survey
tax.what: Introduces a taxonomy of memory-augmented-generation systems by four memory structures and empirically analyzes benchmark saturation, metric validity, and system-level costs.
tax.unique: Taxonomizes by four memory structures and empirically analyzes benchmark saturation, metric validity and system costs.

papers.title: Locomo-Plus: Beyond-Factual Cognitive Memory Evaluation Framework for LLM Agents

tax.name: LoCoMo-Plus
tax.what: Tests retention and application of implicit, unqueried constraints (user state, goals, values) over long conversations using a constraint-consistency evaluation framework.
tax.unique: Tests retention of unqueried implicit constraints via a constraint-consistency framework, not string matching.

papers.title: DeepImageSearch: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Context-Aware Image Retrieval in Visual Histories

tax.name: DeepImageSearch / DISBench
tax.what: Models must plan multi-step exploration over interconnected visual histories to locate target images from implicit contextual cues, using a dual-memory baseline agent.
tax.unique: Reformulates retrieval as multi-step exploration over interconnected visual histories using a dual-memory baseline agent.

papers.title: Beyond RAG for Agent Memory: Retrieval by Decoupling and Aggregation

tax.learns_what: nothing; builds/retrieves hierarchical memory groups by fixed pipeline
tax.unique: Decouples segmented events into memory components then aggregates into groups; retrieval expands top-down only when uncertainty remains.

papers.title: Mnemis: Dual-Route Retrieval on Hierarchical Graphs for Long-Term LLM Memory

tax.name: Mnemis
tax.what: Combines System-1 similarity search over a base graph with System-2 deliberate top-down traversal over a hierarchical graph, then merges both retrieval routes.
tax.learns_what: nothing; dual-route similarity plus graph traversal retrieval
tax.unique: Merges System-1 similarity search over a base graph with System-2 top-down traversal on a hierarchical graph.

papers.title: TraceMem: Weaving Narrative Memory Schemata from User Conversational Traces

tax.what: Segments dialogue into episodes, consolidates them into episodic/semantic traces, then two-stage hierarchical clustering organizes traces into time-evolving narrative threads (memory cards).
tax.learns_what: nothing; LLM pipeline builds narrative memory schemata
tax.unique: Two-stage hierarchical clustering weaves traces into time-evolving narrative threads, retrieved via an agentic search mechanism.

tax.name: EventMemAgent
tax.what: Short-term memory detects event boundaries via reservoir sampling in a fixed buffer; long-term memory archives past events, with RL-internalized tool-use for evidence capture.
tax.learns_what: tool-use and reasoning strategies for active evidence capture
tax.unique: Detects event boundaries via reservoir sampling and uses RL-internalized tool-use for active, iterative evidence capture.

papers.title: M2A: Multimodal Memory Agent with Dual-Layer Hybrid Memory for Long-Term Personalized Interactions

sources.section: Papers - Nonparametric Memory / Multimodal Memory (for Understanding)

tax.name: M2A
tax.what: A ChatAgent decides when to query/update memory while a MemoryManager operates a dual-layer bank: an immutable RawMessageStore plus a higher-level SemanticMemoryStore of concepts.
tax.learns_what: nothing; agents decide memory ops over fixed dual-layer bank
tax.unique: ChatAgent decides when to query/update a dual-layer RawMessageStore plus SemanticMemoryStore via a MemoryManager.

papers.title: Language Model Memory and Memory Models for Language

tax.name: Memory Models for Language
tax.what: An encoder-decoder architecture trained with combined causal and reconstruction objectives forms information-rich latent embeddings that substitute for token sequences.
tax.learns_what: encoder-decoder latent memory embeddings via combined objectives
tax.unique: Encoder-decoder trained with combined causal and reconstruction objectives forms information-rich latent embeddings replacing tokens.

papers.title: MeKi: Memory-based Expert Knowledge Injection for Efficient LLM Scaling

tax.name: MeKi
tax.what: Each Transformer layer gets token-level memory experts, re-parameterized after training into a compact static lookup table stored in ROM, injected at inference with no latency cost.
tax.learns_what: per-layer token memory experts folded into a static lookup table
tax.unique: Token-level memory experts re-parameterized into a static ROM lookup table, zero inference latency overhead.

papers.title: Memory Caching: RNNs with Growing Memory

tax.name: Memory Caching (RNN)
tax.what: Caches checkpoints of an RNN's hidden states so effective memory capacity grows with sequence length, interpolating between fixed RNN memory and quadratic Transformer memory.
tax.learns_what: RNN hidden-state caching mechanism for growing memory capacity
tax.unique: Caches checkpoints of RNN hidden states so effective memory capacity grows with sequence length.

papers.title: MemSkill: Learning and Evolving Memory Skills for Self-Evolving Agents

sources.section: Papers - Memory for Agent Evolution / Reinforcement Learning & Continual Learning

tax.name: MemSkill
tax.what: A controller selects reusable memory-extraction/consolidation/pruning skills, an executor applies them, and a designer periodically reviews failures to refine and add new skills.
tax.learns_what: reusable memory extraction/consolidation/pruning skill set
tax.unique: A designer periodically reviews hard failure cases to propose refinements and entirely new memory skills.

papers.title: ProcMEM: Learning Reusable Procedural Memory from Experience via Non-Parametric PPO for LLM Agents

sources.section: Papers - Memory for Agent Evolution / Reinforcement Learning & Continual Learning

tax.name: Skill-Pro / ProcMEM
tax.what: Interaction episodes are transformed into executable Skills (activation/execution/termination conditions) via a Skill-MDP, verified by a non-parametric PPO gate, without weight updates.
tax.learns_what: reusable procedural skills verified via non-parametric PPO gate
tax.unique: A Skill-MDP turns episodes into activation/execution/termination skills verified by a non-parametric PPO gate.

papers.title: CL-bench: A Benchmark for Context Learning

sources.section: Papers - Memory for Agent Evolution / Context Engineering & Harness Engineering

tax.name: CL-bench
tax.what: 500 expert-crafted contexts with 1,899 tasks test whether models can learn new domain knowledge and rules contained only in the given context, not via retrieval alone.

papers.title: MemGUI-Bench: Benchmarking Memory of Mobile GUI Agents in Dynamic Environments

tax.name: MemGUI-Bench
tax.what: 128 snapshot-based mobile GUI tasks across 26 apps use pass@k and staged LLM-as-judge scoring to test short-term retention and cross-session experience accumulation.
tax.unique: 128 snapshot mobile-GUI tasks with pass@k and staged LLM-judge scoring across 26 apps and 64 mirror pairs.

papers.title: AGENTVISTA: Evaluating Multimodal Agents in Ultra-Challenging Realistic Visual Scenarios

tax.name: AGENTVISTA
tax.what: 25 sub-domains of realistic visual scenarios test long-horizon multimodal tool use (web/image search, navigation, code) for generalist agents; hard cases need 25+ tool calls.

papers.title: MentisOculi: Revealing the Limits of Reasoning with Mental Imagery

tax.name: MentisOculi
tax.what: A stratified suite of multi-step problems tests whether models can form, maintain and manipulate intermediate visual imagery (latent tokens or generated images) to aid reasoning.

papers.title: AMA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Memory for Agentic Applications

tax.name: AMA-Bench
tax.what: Real and synthetic agent-environment trajectories (states, actions, observations, tool outputs) pair with expert QA; the AMA-Agent baseline uses causality-graph construction and tool-augmented retrieval.
tax.unique: Combines real and synthetic agent trajectories with expert QA; AMA-Agent builds causality graphs for retrieval.

papers.title: MemoryArena: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Interdependent Multi-Session Agentic Tasks

tax.name: MemoryArena
tax.what: Human-crafted multi-session tasks with interdependent subtasks require agents to distill experience into memory during earlier sessions and reuse it in later ones.
tax.unique: Unified gym coupling memorization and action across web, planning, search and reasoning multi-session tasks.

papers.title: Plan-MCTS: Plan Exploration for Action Exploitation in Web Navigation

tax.name: Plan-MCTS
tax.what: Shifts MCTS exploration into a semantic Plan Space, distilling noisy web-page context into an Abstracted Semantic History to keep state awareness precise during search.
tax.learns_what: nothing; MCTS search over plan space within one task
tax.unique: Shifts MCTS exploration into a semantic Plan Space, distilling noisy web-page context into an Abstracted Semantic History.

papers.title: Modeling Distinct Human Interaction in Web Agents

tax.name: Modeling Distinct Human Interaction in Web Agents
tax.what: Trains models on the CowCorpus of 400 web trajectories to predict when a human will intervene in agent execution across four interaction patterns.

papers.title: REMem: Reasoning with Episodic Memory in Language Agent

tax.name: REMem
tax.what: Experiences are converted offline into a hybrid memory graph linking time-aware gists and facts; an agentic retriever then iteratively traverses the graph online.
tax.learns_what: nothing; agentic retriever traverses hybrid episodic memory graph
tax.unique: Links time-aware gists and facts offline; agentic retriever traverses the episodic graph online with curated tools.

papers.title: Learning to Continually Learn via Meta-learning Agentic Memory Designs

tax.name: ALMA
tax.what: A Meta Agent searches over memory designs expressed as executable code (database schemas plus retrieval/update mechanisms) to replace hand-engineered memory across domains.
tax.learns_what: memory system design (schema, retrieval/update code) via meta-search
tax.unique: A Meta Agent open-endedly searches executable-code memory designs, including database schemas and retrieval/update logic.

papers.title: When to Memorize and When to Stop: Gated Recurrent Memory for Long-Context Reasoning

tax.name: GRU-Mem
tax.what: Extends MemAgent's chunk-by-chunk textual-memory loop with a learned update gate (skip evidence-free chunks) and exit gate (stop early), trained via RL rewards.
tax.learns_what: update/exit gating policy for recurrent textual memory
tax.unique: Adds a learned update gate (skip evidence-free chunks) and exit gate (stop early) to MemAgent's recurrent textual-memory loop via RL.

papers.title: Memory Matters More: Event-Centric Memory as a Logic Map for Agent Searching and Reasoning

tax.name: CompassMem
tax.what: Experiences are incrementally segmented into events and linked by explicit logical relations into an Event Graph, over which the agent navigates structurally, not just by similarity.
tax.learns_what: nothing; incrementally builds an event logic-map graph
tax.unique: Segments experiences into an Event Graph linked by explicit logical relations for goal-directed structural navigation.

papers.title: MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents

sources.section: Taxonomy / Memory Storage / Hybrid Graph Architectures

tax.name: MAGMA
tax.what: Each memory item is represented across orthogonal semantic, temporal, causal and entity graphs; retrieval is policy-guided traversal over these relational views.
tax.learns_what: nothing; policy-guided traversal over fixed multi-graph views
tax.unique: Represents each memory item across orthogonal semantic, temporal, causal and entity graph views simultaneously.

sources.section: Papers - Nonparametric Memory / Multimodal Memory (for Understanding)

tax.unique: MLP pretrained to imitate a kNN retriever fused with the decoder via probability interpolation.
